title: Laplace Transform Strategy and Equation Walkthrough
full_prompt:
Write a Manim script using ManimGL/InteractiveScene that visualizes the high-level strategy of solving differential equations using the Laplace Transform. 

1. Create a 2x2 layout of terms representing the steps of the Laplace transform method:
   - Top-Left (UL): "Differential Equation"
   - Bottom-Left (DL): "Transformed Equation" (colored Yellow)
   - Bottom-Right (DR): "Transformed Solution" (colored Yellow)
   - Top-Right (UR): "Solution"

2. Create custom labeled arrows connecting these terms:
   - An arrow pointing down from "Differential Equation" to "Transformed Equation" labeled with the Laplace symbol '\mathcal{L}'.
   - An arrow pointing right from "Transformed Equation" to "Transformed Solution" labeled with 'Solve (Algebraically)'.
   - An arrow pointing up from "Transformed Solution" to "Solution" labeled with the Inverse Laplace symbol '\mathcal{L}^{-1}'.

3. Animate the sequential appearance of these terms and arrows:
   - Show the "Differential Equation" term first.
   - Grow the first arrow and transform the "Differential Equation" text into "Transformed Equation".
   - Grow the second arrow and transform "Transformed Equation" into "Transformed Solution".
   - Grow the third arrow and transform "Transformed Solution" into the final "Solution".

4. Add background domain indicators:
   - Divide the screen horizontally into two domains using full-screen rectangles.
   - The top half represents the "Time domain" (outlined in Blue).
   - The bottom half represents the "s domain" (outlined in Yellow).
   - Fade in these domain boundaries and their respective labels in the upper-left corners of each domain.

common_failure_modes.note: FullScreenRectangle is a ManimGL-specific class. In ManimCE, a custom Rectangle with screen dimensions must be used.
TransformMatchingStrings is specific to ManimGL. ManimCE users should use TransformMatchingTex or manual ReplacementTransform.
